evidence: Conversation lookup, missing-thread hydration recursion, and older-history loading are preserved as a typed readiness policy; no UI initialization side effects are copied.
Cross-realm DOM element detection is isolated as a deterministic predicate; ownerDocument constructors and structural fallbacks are preserved without primary runtime registration.
Absolute browser URL formatting is a pure host/path/query/hash projection with no UI or signal lifecycle dependency.
Site URL matching only compares normalized protocol, port, host aliases, and path boundaries; initialization remains in the hub.
Suggested follow-up payload normalization validates, trims, preserves source indexes, and caps output without primary hub side effects.
Attachment summary formatting combines annotation/design-tweak and comment counts through the supplied formatter; the extracted module has no renderer lifecycle or signal registration.

Tenant-subdomain extraction is a deterministic URL/hostname policy with explicit suffix allowlisting; the hub keeps its compatibility export because no independent renderer import currently owns this boundary.

The absolute-URL predicate is only consumed by the adjacent foreground-image selector tAe; no renderer module imports the public alias, so extracting it would create a facade without a real named consumer.

The URL-scheme classifier is an implementation detail of rA/tAe in the generated hub and has no independent renderer call site; preserve the coupled scope until a named consumer establishes a stable contract.
